component.name: Voelin
component.summary: Voice chat, text chat and screen sharing

description.p: A desktop voice client written in Rust: talk with push-to-talk or voice activation, chat in channels you are not in, see who is online without joining, and watch and share screens.

ul.li: Echo cancellation, noise suppression and automatic gain control
Global push-to-talk on Wayland (desktop portal), X11 and Windows

description.p: The first alpha: servers and bookmarks, voice, channel and server chat, TeamSpeak 6 streams, observing servers through the tsgw gateway, myTeamSpeak account sign-in, and host and channel banners.
